title: Towards Robust Evaluation: A Comprehensive Taxonomy of Datasets and Metrics for Open Domain Question Answering in the Era of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper is a comprehensive review and taxonomy of Open-Domain Question Answering (ODQA) datasets and metrics. While it discusses evaluation challenges and various technical biases in LLM-based judges (such as positional, verbosity, and self-enhancement bias), it does not evaluate or benchmark themes related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
